doc.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: New York 1948: Tristano and the Miles nonet
title: Reuniting with Tristano, Warne Marsh and the first band
summary: In New York he got back with Tristano and began playing as a band with Warne Marsh, Billy Bauer, Arnold Fishkin and Jeff Morton.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you get a hold of Tristano then when you came to town?
[We] got back together and talked about . . . I don’t know if we talked about whether Warne was there already, but soon enough we were trying to play together as a band.
So it’s you, Tristano, Warne, and who else?
Billy Bauer, Arnold Fishkin, and Jeff Morton was one of his drum students at the time.
So he was the original drummer?
